purpose: Measure clean-image generalisation from CIFAKE Stable Diffusion training data to a newer, unseen FLUX generator without retraining, threshold changes, or model reselection.

dataset.name: SID-Set
dataset.underlying_real_image_source: Open Images V7 according to the SID-Set dataset card
dataset.underlying_real_image_license: CC-BY-2.0 as listed by Open Images

license_audit.public_artifacts: Code, provenance metadata, aggregate metrics, and figures only.
license_audit.source_documentation_note: The Hugging Face card describes real images as OpenImages V7, while the CVPR paper lists COCO, Flickr30k, and MagicBrush as SID-Set data sources. This source-description inconsistency must be disclosed as a limitation; no source-domain equivalence is assumed.
license_audit.rights_caveat: Open Images advises users to verify the licence status of each image. Because SID-Set's row API does not expose original author attribution, sampled images are restricted to local aggregate evaluation and cannot be used as public qualitative examples.

2.reason: Locally manipulated images are not equivalent to the fully synthetic binary target and require a separate experiment.

task.generator_evidence: The official CVPR 2025 supplement states that SID-Set fully synthetic images were generated with FLUX.
task.held_out_claim: FLUX images and all SID-Set images were excluded from training, validation, threshold selection, and model selection.

sample.page_ordering: Sort page indices by SHA-256 of '<seed>:page:<page_index>'.
sample.candidate_ranking: Within each included label, traverse candidates by the lowest SHA-256 values of '<seed>:row:<row_idx>:<img_id>' from the fetched candidate pool until target_per_class content-unique images are accepted.
sample.stopping_rule: Fetch deterministic pages until at least target_per_class candidates exist for both included labels.
sample.balance_policy: Exactly 1000 real and 1000 fully synthetic images; source label 2 is excluded.
sample.content_deduplication: Reject byte-identical SHA-256 image content within a class and continue to the next deterministically ranked candidate. Identical content with conflicting labels is a fatal data-integrity error.
sample.sampling_limitations: This is a deterministic hackathon-scale subset, not the complete SID-Set validation split.
